(5) The two men are seen standing together on a city street at night next to a painted wall. One man holds a smartphone showing a video of a border collie, while the other man mimics the dog's actions, laughing and moving around.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a humorous bet made during a mahjong tournament. The protagonist vows to bark like a dog if a specific, rare tile is drawn. When the tile is indeed drawn, the video cuts to the fulfillment of the bet, showing the protagonist barking like different dog breeds on a street at night for comedic effect.
